## Desired behavior

Today, if a plugin is not found, you get the following error message logged:
```
[Err] [SystemLoader.cc:92] Failed to load system plugin [x.so] : Could not find shared library.
```

There should be a way to get gazebo to exit early (fail fast) if the plugin is not found, as this indicates a bigger problem which can be hard to debug. The only way that I have found to detect a failed to load plugin would be to parse the standard output/error from gazebo, which is not very robust.

## Implementation suggestion
Environment variable or a `--cli-flag` to enable strict loading of gazebo plugins?
